q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Wang Fang. I’m twelve years old. I live in Shanghai, in China. My favourite time of the year is autumn, because the weather is cool and the trees are beautiful. I don’t often look at the stars, because there are too many lights in the city. Maybe once a month, when I visit my grandparents in the countryside. Last summer I spent a day in a big park with my family. We had a picnic by the lake and rode bikes. The weather was sunny and I was very happy. I chat to my friends online every evening after I finish my homework. The last time I had a meal with a friend was last Saturday. We ate noodles in a small restaurant near my school.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如为什么喜欢某个季节、在公园做了什么、天气怎样），用一般现在时说习惯、用一般过去时讲经历，句子简单正确、前后连贯。

q2.sampleAnswer: I think being a pilot is exciting, because you can fly to lots of different countries. I play the piano, so I think working as a musician is fun. Being a doctor is difficult, because you must study for many years, but it’s a very important job. I don’t think working as a cleaner is boring, because it helps everyone, but it’s hard work. Working as a teacher is interesting, because you meet lots of students every day. I like the pilot best. Yes, I’d like to work in a different country in the future, because I want to learn about other cultures and speak English every day. I think it’s good to earn a lot of money, but it’s more important to enjoy your job.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中的职业（飞行员、音乐家、医生、清洁工、老师）说出喜不喜欢以及原因，回应同伴的提问，回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪种工作，并能谈将来想不想去国外工作、赚很多钱好不好，用 because、but 等把理由说清楚。
